title: Optimality of delayed reward attainment under uncertainty
summary: Decision making under uncertainty requires balancing the value of additional information against the cost of delaying the decision until that information becomes available. This challenge is especially prevalent for embodied decisions such as those faced by animals moving between food sources and robots selecting navigation targets, where movement through space shapes both the quality of information and the cost of acting.
